clock_reset.name: rst_n_i
clock_reset.description: active-low asynchronous reset, synchronous release to clk_i domain

parameters.name: DATA_WIDTH
parameters.description: data width per input and output beat

parameters.name: NUM_INPUTS
parameters.description: fixed number of request inputs in v1.0

expected_behavior.arbitration: round-robin scan from pointer over inputs 0,1,2 with wrap
expected_behavior.pointer_update: advance to granted input plus one only on out_valid_o && out_ready_i
expected_behavior.input_accept: assert only one in_ready_o bit when output register can accept a new beat
expected_behavior.backpressure: hold out_valid_o, out_data_o, and grant_o while out_valid_o is high and out_ready_i is low
expected_behavior.latency: accepted input appears at output one cycle later
expected_behavior.throughput: one output beat per cycle after fill when out_ready_i is high and at least one input remains valid

error_handling.condition: input data changes while valid high and ready low
error_handling.hardware_behavior: samples data when input handshake occurs
holds current output beat and backpressures all inputs
